policy: One primary reading topic per report; titles, existing curated technical keywords, and source abstracts/descriptions for ambiguous entries are the classification evidence.
General model-family releases belong to Foundation models; reports centered on a named architecture, training method, system, or task use that topic.
Code, audio/vision, embodied, and tool-use reports retain their subject even when published as model cards or system cards.
General system cards and explicit safety/evaluation reports belong to Evaluation & verification.
No report is assigned by fallback. New report IDs or changed titles stop the library build until this mapping is reviewed.
